notes: full pie (wedges meet at the centre, page point (441.8, 676.4), radius 45.7 pt); slices listed in legend order top to bottom, fill colours salmon #FA8072, light pink #FFA0A0, light grey #E0E0E0, light blue #ADD8E6, dodger blue #1E90FF

wedge areas from the PDF paths as % of the disc (and as counts of n = 107): Saved more than 50% of my time: 23.36 % = 25/107, printed 23.4%; Saved more than 10% of my time: 27.10 % = 29/107, printed 27.1%; Not sure: 30.84 % = 33/107, printed 30.8%; Delayed me by more than 10%: 15.89 % = 17/107, printed 15.9%; Delayed me by more than 50%: 2.80 % = 3/107, printed 2.8%

uncertain: All 15 values are the percentages printed inside the slices (source 'printed'); each was matched to its legend entry by the wedge's fill colour and confirmed by the wedge area from the PDF paths: every slice equals k/107 (n = 107 per the caption) to within 0.05 percentage points of the printed label.
Printed slices sum to 99.9 (panels a, b) and 100.0 (panel c): rounding in the source, not a missing slice.

Pie panels carry no series (series: [], row series null), as the engine's pie reader emits them; the earlier truth file tests/data/figure_data/truth/F5.json named one series per panel after the panel title, which scores a correct series-less prediction 0 on series F1. Values, labels and categories are otherwise identical to F5.json.

This picture is the top row (three pies) of Fig. 2; the caption attached to it in document.json ('Extended Data Fig. 2. The pie charts display ... five questions related to AI use (n = 107) and the imaging question (n = 214)') is the tail of the Fig. 2 caption. The other three pies of the figure are separate pictures and are not part of this file.

Scorer hazard in panel c: 'Saved more than 50% of my time' / 'Saved more than 10% of my time' and 'Delayed me by more than 10%' / 'Delayed me by more than 50%' differ by one character and count as the same label for the scorer (Levenshtein <= 0.2 of the longer); matching is first-fit, so a prediction that lists the slices in another order than the legend (the order used here) can have these two pairs swapped (23.4 <-> 27.1, 15.9 <-> 2.8).

Panels have no printed letters; ids a-c are reading order (kept from F5.json). bbox_px spans title + pie + legend of each third; the crop's bottom edge cuts ~1 pt of the pies and the last legend line of panel c ('than 50%') is inside the crop.
